title: sphondylium lanatum
intro: Sphondylium lanatum, commonly known as Wood Sorrel or Sheep's Sorrel, is a perennial plant native to Europe, Western Asia, and North Africa. It is valued for its rich source of vitamin C and its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Sphondylium lanatum include treating digestive issues, such as diarrhea and ulcers, and alleviating symptoms of arthritis and other inflammatory conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include oxalic acid, malic acid, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
